label: Huawei SUN2000 L1/M1 hybrid with LUNA2000 battery
status_note: Public register documentation only; nothing verified on hardware. Covers SUN2000-xKTL-L1 (single-phase) and -M1 (three-phase) hybrids, 2-12 kW, with a LUNA2000 battery; MAP0/LC0/M0/M2/USL0 and commercial models, LG RESU batteries, a second battery unit and EMMA/SmartLogger set-ups are not covered. Control is limited to the storage working mode register 47086 (back to 'maximise self consumption'): forced charge/discharge needs prerequisite registers, 32-bit power set-points and scaled SoC targets that the engine cannot write (see docs/profiles/engine-gaps.md); grid charge, forced discharge, sell and standby therefore map to the neutral mode without power and their capabilities are false. Writes over most TCP connections also need the vendor installer login, which the integration does not implement. Live-test checklist: (1) model string at 30000 and rated power at 30073 for the unit; (2) 32-bit values big-endian (high word first) and the scales: SoC 37760 x0.1 %, battery temperature 37022 x0.1 C, bus voltage 37763 x0.1 V; energy totals 37119/37121 may read negative on some firmware, so they are not read; (3) signs: 37765 > 0 while charging and 37113 > 0 while exporting (both negated here), load = 32080 + grid import; (4) unit id 1 through the SDongle or an RS485 gateway; the inverter WLAN access point and 'Local O&M' use unit 0 and port 6607 on newer firmware, not covered by this profile's single unit id; (5) the SDongle answers slowly, wants about 1 s of quiet after a connect and tolerates few simultaneous clients (the FusionSolar app and another Modbus client on it break the session); (6) the safe write is re-writing the current value of 47086 (2 = maximise self consumption) with FC16 and reading it back; restore by writing back the value read before the test; (7) whether 47086 accepts the write without an installer login over the SDongle. Battery temperature limits are the generic defaults of the other profiles, not LUNA2000 data. Not used for control until verified.

modbus.status_note: Community library only. All registers are holding registers (FC3); the reference library writes with FC16 (FC6 acceptance is community-reported, unverified). The SDongle needs about 1 s after connecting before the first request (not expressible here; gap_ms 1000 and a 5 s timeout are a conservative stand-in) and serves few clients at once. The only write is the storage working mode 47086; re-writing its current value is the safe probe. Over TCP the inverter may refuse writes without the installer login; the RS485 path (manual target) does not need it.
